name: Two bedroom — Type B2
summary: An accepted plan anchor exists for this kitchen in the private record. It is withheld from publication because the evidence page carries client drawing identity that cannot be published, so this build ships no source link and the scope reads unresolved. The evidence existed and was reviewed — it is simply not shown here, and an unshown source is not a source. The geometry below is unchanged and was always a designer default; the accessibility envelopes remain derived from published code, which is checkable without any drawing.

footprint.note: Overall dimensions are measured off the unit plan sheet. The sheet itself is withheld, so no source link is published and the type carries no verified claim.

massing.note: Coarse stand-in drawn when this unit's level is not loaded.

dimensions.note: Dimensions are pinned, not parametric. The sink margins here are half an inch; sliders return later as viewing adjustments, once this governing set is agreed.

fixed.label: Unit envelope
fixed.note: Measured off the unit plan sheet. The 23'-4" depth is the one dimension that repeats across every unit type in the set.

fixed.label: Kitchen zone
fixed.note: Designer default. The sheet places a kitchen in this unit but does not dimension the room around the casework.

fixed.label: Wall thickness
fixed.note: Nominal 2×4 partition with two gypsum layers.

fixed.label: Casework run
fixed.note: Four 24 in base modules around a 36 in sink void, no remainder.

fixed.label: Finished work surface
fixed.note: Top of the counter — the plane 606.3 governs. The 1 1/2 in slab sits inside this figure, not on top of it.

fixed.label: Cabinet carcass
fixed.note: 34 in finished surface less the 1 1/2 in countertop.

fixed.label: Countertop
fixed.note: 24 in cabinet with a nominal front overhang.

fixed.label: Toe kick
fixed.note: Millwork toe kick. Distinct from the 9 in ADA toe clearance envelope.

fixed.label: Sink void
fixed.note: Base cabinet omitted. Exceeds the 30 in knee width minimum by 6 in.

fixed.label: Sink bowl
fixed.note: UFAS 4.34.6.5 maximum. Underside lands at 27.5 in — 0.5 in over the requirement.

fixed.label: Knee envelope
fixed.governing: 30 in wide × 19 in deep × 9–27 in AFF
fixed.note: 19 in is the UFAS kitchen-sink figure, well over ADA 306.3's 11 in floor.

fixed.label: Toe envelope
fixed.note: 2010 ADA 306.2.3 minimum where it forms part of the clear floor space.

fixed.label: Upper cabinet
fixed.note: Standard wall cabinet. Omitted over the sink.

fixed.label: Upper cabinet underside
fixed.note: 18 in above the 34 in work surface.
